Good evening, ladies and gentlemen. Flight 506 to Sao Paulo is going to board in twenty minutes, at gate B12. The flight is going to take about twelve hours. We are going to serve dinner after take-off and breakfast before landing. Please have your passport and boarding pass ready. Thank you.

Hi, it's Klaus from Munich. I have big news. Next year, I'm going to open a second shop. It's going to be near the airport, and it's going to have eight lifts. And in March, I'm going to visit Brazil for the first time. I'm going to see the auto parts fair in Sao Paulo. I'm not going to stay long, only one week.

Laura is going to travel to Brazil in March. First, she is going to take a flight from Munich to Sao Paulo. Then she is going to visit an auto parts fair. After the fair, she is going to meet customers at their repair shops. On the last day, she is going to do some sightseeing and buy souvenirs.
